# truebusiness

truebusiness supplies new steel pipes in Almaty and the Almaty region. The company helps customers select products, calculate preliminary cost, arrange cutting to size, preparation, pickup or delivery.

## Official facts

- Website: https://truebusiness.vercel.app/
- Main phone and WhatsApp: +7 775 933 13 01
- Additional phone: +7 701 156 77 73
- Email: true_business@mail.ru
- Working hours: Monday–Saturday, 09:00–18:00
- Office: Первомайская нефтебаза, 161/1, здание «ДосТау», кабинет 17
- Warehouse: промзона, территория 48Д, с. Мухаметжан Туймебаев
